title: The date and the year
description: Finish the year, and talk about birthdays and seasons.
grammar: the names of the months, and the words for a date
grammarNote: A month takes no article, but a birthday and a season do.

explanation.summary: The last two months, and the words you need for a date, a birthday and a season. This is where the months finish and the seasons begin.

sections.heading: The last two months
sections.body: Noviembre and diciembre close the year, and they follow the rule of the others: no article. En noviembre, en diciembre. The date is la fecha, and it is feminine: la fecha es el 5 de noviembre.

examples.es: la fecha es el 5 de noviembre
examples.en: the date is the fifth of November

sections.heading: Birthdays and seasons
sections.body: A birthday takes el: el cumpleaños is on the same day every year. The seasons take their article: la primavera, el otoño. The end of the year is el año nuevo, and the quiet days are el fin de semana.

examples.en: in spring the weather is nice

examples.es: el fin de semana es el sábado y el domingo
examples.en: the weekend is Saturday and Sunday

items.note: Masculine: el cumpleaños. The plural keeps the ñ: los cumpleaños.
Masculine: el otoño. The accent marks the stress.
Feminine: la Navidad. It is always written with a capital N.
